title: Disaster recovery small business grant – storms and floods August and September 2022 onwards – Guidelines
summary: This page provides guidelines for the disaster recovery small business grant following storms and floods in August and September 2022.
who_can_apply: Must be registered with the Australian Charities and Non-for-profits Commission (ACNC) or an equivalent State regulatory body.
Must be recognized by Fair Trading NSW as an incorporated association or co-operative.
Must be deemed a Not-for-Profit Organisation, in accordance with the current Australian Accounting Standards Board (AASB).
Must have derived the majority of income from the Small Business immediately before the Eligible Disaster.
Must have continued to derive the majority of income from the Small Business had the Eligible Disaster not occurred.
Eligible business types include public companies, charitable businesses, and body corporates under the Body Corporate and Community Management Act 1997.
what_you_need: A list of the direct storm and flood-related damage.
Photographic evidence of the direct storm and flood-related damage.
Evidence of Payment for all amounts claimed, including any previous claims.
For grants between $25,000 and $50,000, evidence of payment is required at the time of application.

For property claims, evidence may include a title search and/or Certificate of Title (for owned property), and financial records, photos, video evidence, or a statutory declaration (for property used predominantly for business activities).

faqs.q: What is the maximum funding available?
faqs.a: Funds of up to $25,000 are available to eligible approved applicants, provided they supply a list of storm or flood-related damage with photographic evidence. Funds between $25,000 and $50,000 require evidence of payment at the time of application.

faqs.q: What types of businesses are eligible?
faqs.a: Eligibility criteria include being registered with the Australian Charities and Non-for-profits Commission (ACNC) or an equivalent State regulatory body, or being recognized by Fair Trading NSW as an incorporated association or co-operative, or being deemed a Not-for-Profit Organisation according to AASB standards. Other eligible types include public companies, charitable businesses, and body corporates under the Body Corporate and Community Management Act 1997.

faqs.q: What costs can I claim for?
faqs.a: Claimable costs include those that would not ordinarily have been incurred without the disaster, or costs that exceed the expense of employing a person to clean the property, premises, or equipment. For motor vehicles, the claim must be for a vehicle registered for business use, and the amount is the market value at the time of the disaster.
